name: clew
description: Index a C, C++ or Python repository into a queryable graph — symbols, call edges, callbacks, threads, locks, dataflow, requirement links and prose — and serve it over MCP. Installs four tools AND one PostToolUse hook that prints a constant one-line reminder after Bash/Grep/Glob while the index goes unused, and stops once it is used (disable with CLEW_HOOK_DISABLE=1). Requires the clew-trace package on PATH and the doxygen binary.
